card.name: Leading digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: A single digit that starts a number and is followed by more digits, such as counts, section references, ranges or fold changes. It appears in study sizes, durations, and label cross-references.

modes.label: Counts and quantities
modes.description: First digit of a multi-digit count or amount in running text.

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: Digit inside a numbered section citation such as 5.15 or 1.8.3.

modes.label: Ranges and fold changes
modes.description: Digit after "to" or "and" in a range or fold increase.
